title: GH#2: Avoid private Magento GD methods when saving PNGs

Replace inaccessible parent-private GD background-fill and destroy calls with module-owned alpha handling so transparent PNG saves no longer fatal.

title: GH#3: Handle unset GraphicsMagick compression quality
body:
## Summary

Avoid calling Gmagick::setCompressionQuality when Magento has no configured quality, preserving GraphicsMagick's default and preventing PHP 8.2+ null deprecations.

## Files Changed

CHANGELOG.md, Image/Adapter/GraphicsMagick.php

## Runtime Testing

- **Risk level:** Medium
- **Verification:** self-assessed — Focused _applyOptions behavior harness passed on PHP 8.3 and PHP 8.4; all tracked PHP files pass syntax checks on both versions; git diff --check passes; composer.json validates with pre-existing metadata warnings. The Gmagick extension is not installed locally, so extension-backed PDF rendering was unavailable.

Resolves #3
